questions.question: What is the internal codename of the API rewrite project?
Who currently owns the billing service, and why did ownership change?
questions.gold: Dana owns billing — she took over when Marco went on parental leave (April 2026). Correct answers must name Dana as the current owner; naming Marco as current owner is incorrect.

questions.question: Which Postgres version does the project run on?
questions.gold: Postgres 16 (migrated off 15, completed May 2026). Answering Postgres 15 is incorrect.

questions.question: On which day of the week do deploys happen?
questions.gold: Wednesday (mornings) — moved from Friday in May 2026. Answering Friday is incorrect.

questions.question: What is the project's monthly cloud spend?
questions.note: Never stated. The $40k contractor budget is a deliberate near-miss distractor; quoting it as cloud spend is incorrect.
